headline: Vincent Pastore, Actor on ‘The Sopranos,’ Dies at 80
context: He played Salvatore Bonpensiero, a mobster’s foot soldier turned F.B.I. informant known to his friends as Big Pussy, on the celebrated HBO series.

sources.name: The New York Times
